name: Plays Games Widget
description: A configurable, swipeable feed of playable HTML5 games.
project_description:
Plays Games Widget lets Drupal site owners add an interactive HTML5 games feed to their website using a configurable Drupal block.

 Features 
 
 Embeds the Plays Games interactive game feed directly into Drupal. 
 Provides a configurable Drupal block. 
 Custom width and height settings. 
 Configurable corner radius. 
 Game category selection. 
 Supports multiple independently configured blocks on the same page. 
 Responsive display for desktop, tablet, and mobile. 
 Administration dashboard with live preview and service diagnostics. 
 
 Post-Installation 
 After enabling the module, open the Plays Games Widget dashboard from the Drupal administration interface. Use the Block layout page to place a Plays Games Widget block in any available theme region, then configure its dimensions, category, and corner radius.

 Requirements 
 The module requires an internet connection because game content is provided by the Plays Games service.

 Recommended modules/libraries 
 No additional Drupal modules or third-party libraries are required.
